tickets.title: US004: Off-Platform Payment Agreement
tickets.description:
As a Student buying an item, I want the app to clearly instruct me to pay via cash or Venmo off-platform, so that I comply with the university's legal policy against in-app money processing.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The "Confirm Deal" screen explicitly displays a warning that no money is handled within the app.
2. Pass/Fail: The UI provides a safe text field to exchange Venmo handles or agree on exact cash amounts before the meetup.
